conventions.frame: One spatially homogeneous slice with oriented orthonormal triad e1,e2,e3, epsilon123=+1, unit future normal N, signature(-,+,+,+). Proper SO(3) rotations act jointly on all tensors/vectors. Normal is hypersurface orthogonal; matter vorticity is not inferred.
conventions.physical_units: n_ij,a_i,h=H/c,S_ij=sigma_ij/c have m^-1; Ricci, Lambda, kappa*epsilon_N and kappa*q_i have m^-2. epsilon_N and q_i have J/m^3, with physical energy flux c*q_i and T_0i=-q_i. S is symmetric trace-free. K_ij=-(h delta_ij+S_ij).
conventions.constants: c=299792458 m/s exactly; retain kappa=8*pi*G/c^4 symbolically. Physical J/m^3 displays may use declared G=6.67430e-11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2 as a fixed conversion constant, not an uncertainty model. Core outputs kappa*epsilon and kappa*q do not require fitting G.
conventions.scale: Primary u_star=10^-26 m^-1 is an exact illustrative scale, not measured cosmology. Evaluate normalized n/u_star,a/u_star,h/u_star,S/u_star and rescale curvature/constraint outputs by u_star^2. Repeat identical dimensionless controls at10^-30 and10^-22 m^-1; H=c*h, sigma=c*S.
conventions.no_physical_zero_floor: Never compare dimensionful inputs or curvature to absolute1e-12. Nonzero10^-26 m^-1 structure constants and10^-52 m^-2 curvature must remain nonzero. Exact-zero fixtures use exact structural zeros; uncertain small eigenvalues receive unresolved-sign status instead of relabeling.
conventions.tensor_coordinates: svec(A)=(A11,A22,A33,sqrt2*A12,sqrt2*A13,sqrt2*A23), Euclidean norm equals Frobenius norm. STF basis B1=diag(1,-1,0)/sqrt2; B2=diag(1,1,-2)/sqrt6; B3=(e1e2^T+e2e1^T)/sqrt2; B4 similarly13; B5 similarly23. Preserve all matrix entries and signed vectors, not only eigenvalues or scalar norms.

core_evaluator.domain: Real symmetric n, real a, h>0, STF S, Lambda>=0, finite epsilon_N and q. Valid homogeneous Lie input must satisfy n*a=0; Jacobi violation is INVALID_JACOBI, never repaired by symmetrizing a curvature output. The evaluator may report residuals for incompatible supplied matter, without calling such tuples admissible.
core_evaluator.structure: C^k_ij=sum_l epsilon_ijl*n_lk + a_i*delta_jk - a_j*delta_ik. Gamma_ijk=(C_ijk-C_jki+C_kij)/2, with C_ijk=C^k_ij.
core_evaluator.curvature: R^l_mij=sum_p(Gamma_jmp*Gamma_ipl-Gamma_imp*Gamma_jpl-C^p_ij*Gamma_pml); Ric_jk=sum_i R^i_jik. Retain full Riemann, Ricci, trace and STF Ricci. Use the retained convention, positive roundIX and negativeV sectional curvature.
core_evaluator.momentum: M_i=3*sum_j S_ij*a_j + sum_jkl epsilon_ijk*n_jl*S_kl; r_M=M-kappa*q. Independently compute D_j K_ji-D_i trK=-sum_jp(Gamma_jjp*K_pi+Gamma_jip*K_jp), since homogeneous component derivatives and derivative of trace vanish. It must equal M with the frozen sign.
core_evaluator.outputs: Jacobi vector and normalized residual; full spatial connection/Riemann/Ricci and STF Ricci; Hamiltonian and three momentum residuals; extrinsic and matter inputs; dimensionful and normalized arrays; exact/numerical equivalence flags. No automatic physical Bianchi classification from floating-point rank.
core_evaluator.canonical_oracle: For a=(a,0,0), n=diag(n1,n2,n3), n1*a=0: Ric_ii=[n_i^2-(n_j-n_k)^2]/2-2*a^2; Ric_23=Ric_32=a*(n2-n3); other off-diagonals zero. Use as independent finite oracle for the direct connection evaluator, not a formula on invalid Jacobi inputs.

new_jacobian_product.class_A_map: For arbitrary real symmetric N=n/u_star,a=0: mathcalR(N)=2*N^2-tr(N)*N+[tr(N)^2/2-tr(N^2)]*I. This rotation-covariant polynomial follows from retained diagonal Ricci and SO(3) covariance; compare it to the direct connection implementation.
new_jacobian_product.hessian: D2R[D,E]=2*(D E+E D)-tr(D)*E-tr(E)*D+[tr(D)*tr(E)-2*tr(D E)]*I. The expansion through this Hessian is exact because the map is quadratic.
new_jacobian_product.geometry_J: Construct actual6x6 Jacobian in the orthonormal svec basis at II,VII0-matched,I,andflatVII0. Record all singular values, left/right singular tensors, rank and null residuals. Expected exact ranks6,6,0,3 respectively. Do not merely print these expected numbers.
new_jacobian_product.rank_controls: At flatVII0, kernel includes the normalized radial matrix diag(0,1,1) and symmetric12/13 directions. At I the Jacobian vanishes but R(t*N_II)=t^2*R(N_II) is nonzero for t!=0. Thus a zero derivative is not a constant nonlinear image. Test t=1/2,1/4,1/8. Along N(t)=Rz(t)*diag(0,1,1)*Rz(t)^T the exact geometry stays flat; a straight tangent line need not stay on that curved flat manifold.
new_jacobian_product.joint_map: z=(svec(N), hbar, STF5(Sbar)) has12 coordinates. With a=0 and Lambdabar=0 define Y(z)=(svec(mathcalR), ebar=3*hbar^2-0.5*Sbar:Sbar+0.5*tr(mathcalR), qbar_i=sum_jkl epsilon_ijk*N_jl*Sbar_kl), dimension10. Retain the12 input coordinates with Y; density and flux are graph outputs chosen to satisfy constraints, not independently measured data.
new_jacobian_product.joint_derivatives: Compute actual10x12 J and10 Hessian matrices at all four centers. Derive by differentiating the displayed quadratic map. Save singular values, input right-singular tensor combinations and output left-singular combinations; no anticipated rank is substituted for computation.
new_jacobian_product.verification: Compare analytic derivatives with complex-step derivative of the polynomial at step10^-30 in dimensionless coordinates (no conjugating norm inside the map). Compare exact quadratic Taylor reconstruction to direct evaluation on the frozen probes. No new generic CAS/four-axis campaign is required.

uncertainty_image.status: Deterministic synthetic tensor uncertainty set, not empirical error bars, Gaussian covariance, probability or coverage.
uncertainty_image.domain: At each of the four class-A centers take z=z0+L*xi, ||xi||2<=1. L has diagonal(1/20 repeated6,1/20,1/100 repeated5) and additional zero-based entry L[7,5]=1/200. Thus one geometric/shear direction is explicitly coupled. LL^T is an ellipsoid shape matrix, not an estimated covariance. The set may include multiple nearby class-A sign/rank strata; only its center has the named witness type.
uncertainty_image.physical_restriction: a=0 makes Jacobi exact throughout the set; Lambda=0. Use the quadratic bound below to check h>0 and ebar>0 on the entire set. Outside the centers q need not vanish, so do not label the whole image orthogonal dust or single perfect fluid. Arbitrary pressure/stress/evolution remain unspecified.
uncertainty_image.probes: Use center and xi=plus/minus e_i and (plus/minus e_i plus/minus e_j)/sqrt2 for all i<j. Evaluate both radii1/2 and1, giving577 unique prescribed probes per center. These are deterministic visualization/falsifier points, not independent samples or a full image boundary.
uncertainty_image.exact_quadratic_enclosure: For any fixed output covector w, f=w.Y, g=J^T*w, H_w=sum_k w_k*H_k. For delta=L*xi the exact change is g^T*L*xi+0.5*xi^T*L^T*H_w*L*xi. Therefore f lies in f0 plus/minus[||L^T*g||2+0.5*||L^T*H_w*L||op]. This is a conservative whole-set support enclosure, not an exact extrema claim or a sample-based confidence interval.
uncertainty_image.directions: Compute bounds for all10 output coordinates and the scalar trace. Also use the unit STF D=diag(-1,2,-1)/sqrt6 and x_D=D:Ric/u_star^2. Its centers are -1/sqrt6 and5/sqrt6 for II andVII0. D is a declared mathematical discriminant, not a calibrated observed sky direction. Retain the full tensor image behind it.
uncertainty_image.tensor_bound: Obtain a conservative full-Ricci deviation norm from the six coordinate bounds. Compare the minimum SO(3)-orbit center separation, equal to the Euclidean distance between sorted Ricci eigenvalue vectors, with the sum of these radii. If the bound proves separation, report conditional set separation; if it does not, report this bound inconclusive, not intersection.
uncertainty_image.nonlinear_comparison: For every probe retain directY, linearY0+Jdelta, exact quadratic reconstruction and linearization error. Show I has a nontrivial quadratic image despite zero geometryJ. Never propagate only JLL^T J^T and call it the exact nonlinear uncertainty.
uncertainty_image.plot: Produce standalone PNG/PDF: (1) scalarRicci versus signed x_D, direct probes, tangent image and conservative rectangular projection bounds; (2) sorted Ricci center spectra with conditional whole-set bounds; (3) geometry singular values/rank including exact-zero I/flat branches. Mark synthetic uncertainty, fixed units and presentation equivalence; plots consume generated arrays.

tolerances.basis: float64 epsilon=2^-52. Finite3D quadratic contractions have bounded operation count; use4096*epsilon for dimensionless relative residuals against the natural polynomial scales below. This is arithmetic validation, not a physical uncertainty or nonzero-class threshold. Retained LRS residuals are of order10^-15; inherited dimensionless1e-12 scale is consistent with this margin.
tolerances.scales: Symmetry/trace denominator is input Frobenius norm. Jacobi scale ||N||F*||A||2. Curvature scale (||N||F+||A||2)^2. Hamiltonian scale3*hbar^2+|ebar|+|Lambdabar|+0.5*||Sbar||F^2+0.5*|Rbar|. Momentum scale3*||A||*||Sbar||F+2*||N||F*||Sbar||F+||qbar||. If a scale is exactly zero, demand exact-zero result; do not insert a unitful or dimensionless floor that erases a small input.
tolerances.Jacobian: Analytic/complex-step and quadratic-reconstruction residuals<=4096*epsilon relative to the corresponding polynomial term-norm sum. Rank threshold tau=256*epsilon*max(m,n)*sigma_max of the normalized Jacobian. J exactly zero has rank0. Report any singular value in[tau/16,16*tau] as unresolved numerical rank; do not round physical structures to achieve a target rank.
tolerances.singular_tensors: Degenerate singular-vector bases are nonunique: validate subspace projector/reconstruction and null residuals, not component-wise eigenvector equality or sign. Preserve full singular spectra and coordinate scale.
tolerances.bounds: Add only a recorded roundoff enclosure based on4096*epsilon times the bound term-norm sum. A failed positivity/separation bound is inconclusive unless an actual invalid/counterexample tuple is exhibited. No post-outcome tolerance relaxation.
